description: Bank uses Money In / Money Out columns and DD/MM/YYYY dates (day-first decidable: 13, 17, 21, 28). A vendor refund (money in from Officeworks) matches a positive credit note. Koala pays INV 8812 38 days after the invoice, quoting the invoice number, exact amount.
notes: Bank row 1 vs ledger row 1 is outside the 7-day window, but carries the invoice number and the exact amount; a sensible bookkeeper matches it, so it is expected as matched (a strict implementation that leaves both unmatched is defensible under the literal policy). Bank row 7 (990.00, 43 days after INV 8840) has no invoice number, so it stays unmatched on both sides.
